sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:38

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:38:1
items.html:
These ten Nekudot were one above the other: The ten Nekudot that he mentions here — he did not come here to be precise; for in truth only the seven lower Nekudot were one above the other, whereas the three first among them were in the correction of the lines, as is known from all the places.
And the reason the seven lower Nekudot were in a single line, one below the other, is that the matter of the correction of the lines came out by the force of the ascent of NHY to HGT, whereby phase two and phase four became included together, as above (page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG”). For then Malchut became included in each and every Sefira, up to Hochma, and because of this a line of Hesed and a line of judgment came into being in each and every Sefira; and through the coupling that raises reflected light they were united one with the other, in the secret of mercy, as is written in its place. And the beginning of this correction was made in the Partzuf of Nekudim that came out from the Nikvey Einayim of SAG. However, this light reached only the GAR of the Nekudim, and not the seven lower ones; and therefore the seven lower vessels remained without the correction of the lines.
And you must know here that the vessels of every Partzuf were made from those vessels of the Partzuf above it, after the departure of their lights from within them, as above (page 318, the passage beginning “And he has already explained.” Study it there well). And with this you will understand that the vessels of the ten Sefirot of the Nekudim were made from the nine lower Sefirot of SAG, which were drawn below the Tabur and from which the light departed at the time of the restriction of NHY of AK. And therefore, since there was as yet no correction of the lines in SAG, the seven lower vessels came out in a single line. But the GAR, which received from the coupling in the Nikvey Einayim, came out in the correction of the lines. And although the seven lower vessels too took from the look of the Einayim into the AHP, (49) this small illumination is not sufficient for them for the correction of the lines.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:38:2
items.html: The length of their stature was like the length of Atzilut and its stature now. For from the partnership of phase four with phase two and their mutual inclusion, the new point of restriction came into being in the worlds, that is, in the place of phase two of the ten Sefirot of the Sium, as above, page 420, the passage beginning “And the arms.” For the first Partzuf that came out in the measure of the new Sium is the Partzuf of Nekudim, and after it all the Partzufim of Atzilut. And that place, from the old point of restriction, which is in this world, up to the new point of restriction, is what is called the place of the three worlds BYA. And since they stand in this place, which is after the point of restriction that was renewed, these three worlds are therefore called the three worlds of separation. And this is what he says, that the level of the Nekudim and the level of the world of Atzilut have one and the same length; and from there downward is the world of Beria, as explained.
